description: SA-MLP Dynamic Equivalency of IEEE 118 Bus System is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Paul Muia Musyoka, Cosmas Kiruki (South Eastern Kenya University). This Dataset includes four folders named: Algorithm Flowchart, Simulation Code, Supplementary Material and Training Scenarios. The folder named Algorithm Flowchart has PNG files illustrating the continuation flowchart that conceptualizes the simulation code, whereas the folder named Simulation Code contains source code files in python used to run the simulations. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
